Are you passionate about sports and looking for an exciting career in logistics? Join our dynamic team at Decathlon's ultra-modern warehouse in Tilburg! We're seeking enthusiastic individuals to help manage our international distribution center, serving stores and customers across multiple European countries.

Your role in our team
As a Logistics Employee at Decathlon, you'll be part of a dedicated team responsible for ensuring smooth operations in our state-of-the-art facility. Your main duties will include:

- Processing orders efficiently using advanced robotic systems

- Collaborating with team members to meet daily goals and targets

- Maintaining high standards of accuracy and safety in all operational processes

- Opportunity to develop into specialized roles such as 'captain' or 'trainer'

What we offer
At Decathlon, we value our employees and offer a range of benefits to support your growth and well-being:

- Competitive starting salary of €2338.27 per month (38-hour week), with potential for monthly bonuses

- 8% holiday pay and 24 vacation days

- 20% discount on Decathlon products

- Comprehensive training and development opportunities

- Employee share ownership program

- Travel expense reimbursement (100% for bike/public transport, 50% for car up to 30km)

- Access to sports coaching and wellness platforms

- Regular team events and outings

What we're looking for
The ideal candidate for this role will possess:

- A passion for sports and an active lifestyle

- Flexibility to work 32-38 hours per week, including one weekend day

- Availability for various shifts (morning, afternoon/evening, night)

- Excellent command of English

- Valid Dutch passport/visa/work permit

- Residence within a 30-minute radius of our Tilburg warehouse

- Alignment with our core values: vitality, generosity, responsibility, and authenticity

About Decathlon
Decathlon is a global leader in sporting goods retail, committed to making sports accessible to all.

As a Customer Service Representative, you will be reporting to the Manager Customer Operations. You will be responsible for:- Serve as the primary point of contact for B2B partners across Europe, managing all enquiries via phone and email, including order processing, complaint resolution, and special projects.
- Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with both internal and external stakeholders, working closely with sales teams and business partners to ensure a high level of service.
- Manage the end-to-end order process using SAP and Excel, monitoring order status, product availability, and delivery timelines to ensure accurate and timely fulfilment.
- Provide partners and B2B customers with detailed product information, proactively addressing enquiries and identifying appropriate solutions to meet their needs.
- Monitor existing processes, identify opportunities for improvement, and implement innovative solutions to increase efficiency and enhance the customer experience.
- Work effectively with vendor portals and internal systems to manage partner requirements and ensure accurate and timely processing of information.
- Collaborate with internal departments, including Accounts Receivable and Marketing, to resolve issues, support business needs, and ensure smooth cross-functional communication.
- Handle customer complaints and complex enquiries professionally, taking ownership of issues through to resolution while maintaining strong commercial relationships.
- Provide day-to-day support to B2B clients and partners across Europe, ensuring a consistently high level of service for both internal and external customers.
- Apply strong commercial and customer-focused skills within a B2B environment, contributing to partner satisfaction, business retention, and overall commercial objectives.

Requirements- Higher professional education or equivalent experience
- Good command of English and French
- Experience within a similar B2B Commercial position

Are you looking for a logistics job with more responsibility than just picking orders?
 As a Logistics Quality Controller, you check incoming fruit and vegetables before they are sent to supermarkets across the Netherlands. You inspect products for quality, freshness and shelf life. If something is not right, you report it immediately and make sure extra checks are carried out when needed.
 You also help with stock counts and other logistics tasks in the warehouse. You will work for a large, modern fruit and vegetable company with plenty of opportunities to grow.
 

Wat wij zoeken- You have some experience in logistics and work accurately
- You speak Dutch or English and are available full-time
- You take responsibility and keep a good overview

Wat jij gaat doen- Check incoming fruit and vegetables for quality and freshness
- Help with stock counts and other logistics tasks in the warehouse
- Report damaged or poor-quality products to the right department

Ons teamYou will work in a large, modern warehouse where fresh fruit and vegetables are handled every day. The team is international, practical and works closely together to make sure only good-quality products reach the customer.
Wat wij bieden- €3,000 – €3,300 per month, plus shift allowances
- Full-time job with plenty of opportunities to grow
- Free gym facilities and extra employee benefits

Warehouse Employee Fresh Products Work with fresh fruit and vegetables in a modern 40,000 m² distribution centre. Using a scanner and EPT, you will pick orders, transport pallets and prepare products for delivery to supermarkets throughout the country. This is an active, fast-paced job within an international team. You have experience in logistics, can operate an EPT and speak sufficient English or Dutch. Looking for a stable, full-time job with plenty of work and good colleagues? Apply today! Wat wij zoeken Experience in logistics or warehouse work and able to operate an EPT Je ziet wat erGood communication of English or Dutch and able to work well in a team Physically fit, accurate and comfortable working at a fast pace Wat jij gaat doen Check that orders are complete, accurate and ready on time Pick fresh fruit and vegetable orders using a scanner and EPT Transport pallets and prepare orders for shipment Ons team You will work in a modern 40,000 m² distribution centre with an international and supportive team. The workplace is fast-paced, well organised and focused on fresh products. Wat wij bieden Salary between €2,900 and €2,975 per month Allowances up to 40%, increasing your earnings to approximately €3,500 A stable full-time job, free gym access and use of the company restaurant

As a Customer Service Representative for the DACH market, you will join 4–5 other German speakers in a close-knit team, working together to support customers and keep everything running smoothly. Some of your tasks include:- Be the main contact for a group of customers and build good relationships with them
- Keep an eye on sales results and share updates with the team
- Spot any issues or changes in customer needs and make sure the right people are informed
- Support the sales team by keeping things running smoothly and following up when needed
- Help track sales targets and contribute ideas to improve results
- Coordinate shipments and deliveries, making sure everything arrives on time
- Take into account customer agreements and country-specific requirements
- Handle customer orders from start to finish, making sure everything is correct
- Manage the order process and adjust priorities when needed
- Identify potential issues early on and solve them proactively
- Work together with other teams on topics like payments and documentation
- Answer customer questions about orders, deliveries, and products

Requirements- At least 1 year of experience in a similar role, or a strong motivation to start a career in customer service
- German at C1 or C2 level, with fluent English for internal communication
- You live within reasonable commuting distance of Helmond
- Availability for 32–40 hours per week
- A customer-focused mindset, with strong organizational and multitasking skills
- Excellent communication skills

BenefitsOur client offers a great benefits package, including:- A flexible hybrid working model (after onboarding, only 2 office days per week — Tuesdays and Thursdays)
- 1 year direct contract with the client, with the intention to go to a permanent contract after
- 13th month salary
- Performance-based annual bonus
- Travel allowance
- Company laptop and phone
- Pension scheme
- 28 vacation days

Are you highly organized, commercially minded, and energized by coordinating projects from start to finish? Do you enjoy working with multiple stakeholders and ensuring that products, timelines, and customer expectations all come together successfully?

We are looking for a German-speaking Commercial Project Coordinator to oversee the successful execution of customer projects within an international retail environment. In this role, you will serve as the bridge between sales, sourcing, operations, and external partners to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and according to agreed specifications.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a strong interest in both project management and sales who enjoys working in a fast-paced, international setting.

- Coordinate and manage customer projects from initial brief through final delivery.
- Translate customer requirements and commercial agreements into clear internal action plans.
- Monitor project timelines, milestones, and deliverables across multiple departments.
- Act as a central point of coordination between internal teams and external partners.
- Identify potential bottlenecks, delays, or risks and proactively drive solutions.
- Ensure accurate execution of product specifications, packaging requirements, pricing information, and logistical details.
- Prepare and maintain project documentation, customer files, and reporting.
- Support customer implementation activities and follow up on ongoing projects.
- Collaborate closely with Sales, Purchasing, Supply Chain, Quality, and Product Development teams. Close collaboration is largely with the Head of Sales and Account Managers Germany.
- Maintain a clear overview of multiple simultaneous projects and communicate project status to stakeholders.

Requirements- Fluent German (C1+), combined with strong English communication skills.
- Experience within a retail, FMCG, consumer goods, sourcing, and/or private-label environment is a MUST.

Do you enjoy working in a fast-moving warehouse and know your way around a forklift? For an international logistics company in Eindhoven, we are looking for an experienced Forklift Driver.
 You will move, load and unload goods, mainly air cargo, using a forklift or reach truck. You also help prepare orders, scan shipments and make sure products are stored in the right place. Safety and accuracy are important, but you also know how to keep the operation moving when it gets busy. You can work in one of two shifts: 08:00 – 16:30 or 12:00 – 20:30.
 

 You speak Dutch or English, have a valid forklift certificate and already have experience driving a forklift.
 Interested? Apply now!
Wat wij zoeken- Comfortable working in a fast-paced team environment
- Confident and experienced in operating a forklift
- Reliable, safety-conscious and accurate

Wat jij gaat doen- Load, unload and move goods safely through the warehouse
- Operate forklift and reach truck equipment throughout the shift
- Prepare orders and help keep the warehouse flow organized

Ons teamYou will work in a modern and well-organized warehouse in Eindhoven. The team is international, friendly and hands-on, with colleagues helping each other to keep the daily operation running smoothly.
Wat wij bieden- Choice between two different work shifts
- Monthly salary between €2.600 and €2.800
- Stable job in an international and supportive team

Are you looking for the perfect part-time job? Then you've come to the right place! Manpower is looking for postal sorters for PostNL in Zwolle at Anthony Fokkerstraat 2, 8013 NS. What we ask of you is that you can come with your own transport, in connection with accessibility. There is no guarantee of hours in this role. You work based on the work that PostNL has to offer. It is important that you are available for at least 15 hours per week! An average shift lasts 3 to 5 hours. Because it depends on how much work there is at PostNL, the number of hours you can work can vary per week.

Employment agency Manpower is looking for postal sorters for the night shift at PostNL in Zwolle.

As a postal sorter, you are responsible for the mechanical sorting of national mail. This is a physical job, because you work standing up and regularly lift heavy boxes of mail. It is also important that you can work accurately, because the mail must be delivered to the correct address!

This is what you get

    -  €14.99 per hour
    
- Travel allowance in accordance with PostNL regulations
    
- Temporary employment contract via Manpower
    
- Pension accrual via Manpower
    
- Access to more than 200 courses via the Manpower Academy
    
- Irregularity allowance of 20% for working between 20:00 and 22:00, and 40% for working between 22:00 and 6:00

    - Good command of Dutch and/or English, in connection with the safety instructions and because of the communication
    
- Own transport, for the morning, evening and night shift
    
- Able to provide a VOG

You can start as a postal employee as soon as possible. So don't wait any longer and apply today! Manpower will then contact you within two working days.

Are you an experienced forklift driver looking for a stable full-time job with good pay and attractive allowances? 
 Join a growing company in the food industry and become an important part of the logistics process.
 As a forklift driver, you move and store packaging materials, supply production and packing departments, load trucks and make sure stock is stored in the correct location. We are looking for someone with forklift experience and a valid certificate. You speak English, work safely and accurately, and are available for rotating shifts, including Saturdays.
 

 Interested? Apply today!
Wat wij zoeken- You have experience working as a forklift driver and hold a valid forklift certificate
- You speak English and are available for rotating shifts between 05:30 and 23:00, including Saturdays
- You work safely and accurately, can work independently, and are comfortable keeping track of stock and quantities

Wat jij gaat doen- Load trucks, check stock levels, and make sure everything is stored in the correct location
- Move and store packaging materials safely using a forklift
- Supply the production and packing departments with the materials they need

Ons teamYou will work in a busy and international logistics environment with a friendly, hands-on team. The workplace is dynamic and well organized, with a strong focus on safety, teamwork and getting the job done together.
Wat wij bieden- A gross salary between €2,900 and €3,300 per month, depending on experience
- 26 vacation days, travel allowance, and a good pension scheme
- Shift allowances ranging from 25% and 40% up to 200%

An aaa-wesome salary of €18,28 plus working for the one and only brand of Coca-Cola? As a heftruckchauffeur this has now become reality! And even with a great starting salary you'll also get great allowances! Up to 40%! Explore the magic at Coca-Cola in Dongen, and read on! 
Don't have a WhatsApp? Then we'll contact you by phone or email! 
 what we offer 
 A salary of €18,28 per hour 
 After 17:30 a 30% and 00:00 even a 40% allowance 
 Travelallowance 
 Growth opportunities 
 Prospect of a permanent contract with Coca-Cola 
 Get paid during your break 
 who you are 
To start as a heftruckchauffeur at Coca-Cola, it's important you meet the following requirements: - You have at least 1 year of recent experience driving the forklift; - You have a valid Dutch forklift certificate; - You are fulltime available in 3 shifts; - You are okay with a flexibel schedule, working 2-4 days a week; - You speak Dutch or English; - You have your own transportation to Dongen; - You're able to learn to drive an 8 ton forklift in a short amount of time. 
 what will you do 
As a heftruckchauffeur you'll work in the logistics department on a 8 ton heftruck. That's a very big heftruck! At Coca-Cola they use a Linde H80 heftruck. You'll be working outside. That can be quit wobbly! Luckily you can keep your load safe with the tilted forks . You'll mostly transport liquids. You'll load them into the trucks from the side or from behind. 
Pfew, you've definitely deserved a break after loading a couple trucks. You'll have a break with your colleagues, and even get paid during your break! 
A heftruckchauffeur at Coca-Cola works a three shift schedule, so get ready for a whole bunch of shift allowances!

In addition, there’s an opportunity to work in other departments, making your job even more diverse and dynamic. What you can expect from us: An attractive gross hourly wage of €15,70; A full-time workweek from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM; Do you live outside Zeewolde? You’ll receive a travel allowance of €0.23 per kilometer; Work for a stable employer with a pleasant and friendly team atmosphere; With good performance, there’s the possibility of a direct contract with the company; And of course, you’ll have a dedicated contact person who’s always there to help you with any questions! Do you want to work for a leading family-owned company that has been active in the international market for over forty years? Our client in Zeewolde is a true specialist in lighters and produces more than one hundred million consumer packages each year. From natural and barbecue lighters to fluids, gels, and lamp oil – you’ll be contributing to innovative, high-quality products that are distributed worldwide.
